text:
You need someone who can help run and coordinate a growing multi-site e-commerce operation across both junior execution tasks and senior-level analytics, automation, and project management.

Hi Sebastien,

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to support your team as an e-commerce manager who can handle both day-to-day website operations and the more strategic work behind growth.

With 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m comfortable working in structured environments where accuracy, communication, and follow-through matter. I also work with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, which means I can help organize data, monitor performance, and create clear reporting to support decisions across your websites.

For the junior side of the role, I can help with product launches, merchandising coordination, content coordination, website administration, and email coordination. On the senior side, I can support data analytics and tracking, reporting in Google Analytics, and project management through clear communication with developers and other stakeholders. I’m also comfortable adapting to fast-moving startup environments where priorities shift and a self-starter is needed.

One relevant project I completed was a Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, an e-commerce client. I built a model that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and compared first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. As a result, 18% of ad budget was reallocated, and customer acquisition cost went down 12% the next quarter.

I understand you’re working across Magento, Shopify, Google Analytics, Klaviyo, Wix, and Squarespace. While I’m not claiming specific hands-on platform administration beyond the tools and analytics work I’ve described, I learn systems quickly and can slot into established workflows with minimal ramp-up. I’m also comfortable collaborating closely with developers and keeping tasks moving with clear communication.

This sounds like the kind of role where I could contribute immediately and grow with the department as you expand. I’d welcome the chance to discuss how I can help support your current websites and upcoming launches.

Best,
Mina Castellan
